note: How the Latin Library's page of Hyginus, De astronomia 2 is read: B. Bunte's text (Leipzig, 1875), as the scans at archive.org print it (hyginiastronomi00hygigoog, bub_gb_W0R9pZXoDPoC). Each correction sets a typing slip of the page right to Bunte's reading, and is found on the page exactly once. The page numbers chapters but not sections, so each section opens at the Latin words given here, matched to Grant's English paragraph of the same id on ToposText; a chapter's first section opens at the chapter, and the book's preface is 2.pr (docs/LIBRARY_PLAN.md §4.4).
